site.name: Alpine Mine
overview: Alpine Mine is a documented historic gold mine in Pitkin County's Columbia (Ashcroft) mining district. USGS-derived topographic mapping preserves the named mine at approximately 39.049990, -106.797816, providing a defensible identification point without implying present-day access or surviving open workings.
moreHistory: Available retained sources consistently place this Alpine Mine in the Ashcroft-area Columbia mining district and distinguish it from same-name mines elsewhere in Colorado and Nevada. The current evidence supports the mine's identity, district, commodity, and mapped location, but does not establish a reliable operator chronology, production total, or surviving condition, so those details are left unstated.
